# interval overlaps

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:intervalOverlaps`](gmeow-intervalOverlaps.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/intervalOverlaps>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Allen OVERLAPS: this interval begins before and ends during the related interval. NOT transitive. Inverse of [`gmeow:intervalOverlappedBy`](gmeow-intervalOverlappedBy.md). (= [time:intervalOverlaps](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalOverlaps))

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when one interval starts before another and ends partway into it — partial overlap with a shared middle stretch but distinct start and end.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when one interval wholly contains the other (use gmeow:intervalContains/gmeow:intervalDuring) or they merely touch (use [`gmeow:intervalMeets`](gmeow-intervalMeets.md)); OVERLAPS is the proper-partial case and is NOT transitive.

### How to use

- Assert from the earlier-starting interval to the later one; the inverse [`gmeow:intervalOverlappedBy`](gmeow-intervalOverlappedBy.md) follows automatically (= [time:intervalOverlaps](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalOverlaps)).

### Examples

- ex:firstReign [`gmeow:intervalOverlaps`](gmeow-intervalOverlaps.md) ex:secondReign.
